owner_statements.question: Nothing is queued after #476. Which slice should come next?

scope: Saving over an existing save keeps no backup (#467): FileSaveDocumentStore.Save replaces the document with File.Replace(..., destinationBackupFileName: null), so one save after New game destroys a long playthrough. Keep one backup generation beside the document and pin it with a test.
boundary: FileSaveDocumentStore backup generation, its unit test, cleanup of backups that smoke checks leave in the temp directory, and dependent documentation/publication. No restore UI, no overwrite confirmation, no save schema change. No merge or release.
publication: Standing owner authority: ALWAYS commit and push when you finish a task. Review branch only.
